requirements.description: I/B/E/S US individual analyst FY1 detail forecasts sufficient to identify revisions, the same analyst’s prior FY1 forecast, outstanding forecast counts and revision event timestamps.

required_coverage.population: US firms and analysts in the October 1993–December 1998 revision sample
required_coverage.detail: The initial sample requires a same-analyst prior forecast; the source does not state how far back that forecast may precede the Oct 1993 sample start. Current detail fields contain candidate analyst, estimate, date and forecast-period columns.

requirements.description: Prior I/B/E/S consensus FY1 forecast for each event, using the source’s daily available consensus definition and retaining stale forecasts as described in its footnote.

required_coverage.population: US sample firms at each forecast revision from October 1993 through December 1998
required_coverage.detail: The consensus reference date is the latest prior consensus relative to each revision; exact consensus date cadence and needed pre-October-1993 history are not bounded.

routes.mapping_notes: Live summary fields provide candidate consensus mean/median and estimate counts. The paper states it mimics daily available consensus and retains stale forecasts; precise version, timestamp and prior-consensus mapping remain unverified.

requirements.description: Daily CRSP firm returns, prices and shares outstanding for three-day event returns, 6/12-month future buy-and-hold returns, lagged six-month momentum, market adjustment and NYSE size-decile portfolios.

required_coverage.population: CRSP US common stocks, including sample firms and the NYSE universe used for size deciles and market-adjusted returns
required_coverage.detail: Sample revisions run October 1993–December 1998; prior calendar-year size inputs reach 1992, and the 12-month future holding window after a late-1998 revision can extend into 1999. Daily portfolio returns require common-stock/security-history filters.

routes.mapping_notes: Daily returns, prices, shares and security identifiers are present. Source uses buy-and-hold equal-weighted NYSE size-decile portfolios; decile and adjusted-return conventions are not established by field presence alone.
routes.coverage_notes: The exact-resource probe verifies accessibility and the named live columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation supports the required historical period/population.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No local historical/population coverage confirmation is supplied; construction must separately reproduce NYSE-size deciles and the paper’s adjusted/unadjusted return convention.

requirements.description: Annual Compustat Price, Dividend, and Earnings inputs for last-calendar-year size and book-to-market ratio, with identifiers and reported annual date.

required_coverage.detail: Last calendar-year market capitalization starts at year-end 1992 for October 1993 revisions. The exact book-value and market-value components of B/M are not reported; original PDE product and current standardized product may differ.

routes.mapping_notes: Current annual fields expose candidate equity, price, share-count, date and firm-identifier columns. The paper names a historical Compustat PDE product; current-version variable mapping and the exact B/M components are unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: The exact-resource probe verifies accessibility and the named live columns only. No coordinator coverage confirmation supports the required historical period/population.

requirements.description: Annual Institutional Investor All-Star and Wall Street Journal Earnings-Estimator rankings by analyst name, industry and rank, with effective date before each forecast revision.

required_coverage.population: Analysts issuing FY1 revisions in the US sample
required_coverage.detail: All-Star means ranks 1–3 or runner-up; Earnings-Estimator means WSJ ranks 1–5. Rankings apply for the 12 months after inclusion; conservative start includes prior-year ranking to cover first-period revisions.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The paper identifies published ranking sources, but no exact local route or reviewed historical public archive was established for 1992–1998.

variable_coverage.construction: Size-adjusted buy-and-hold firm return from day +2 through +127 (Ret6) or +253 (Ret12), less the equal-weighted return of same NYSE size-decile firms.
Forecast revision = 100 × (new FY1 forecast − same analyst prior FY1 forecast) / closing price on day t−1; paper winsorizes extreme 1% tails. Forecast-history spacing is not bounded.
Three-day return centered on the revision date; firm buy-and-hold return minus the equal-weighted return of the same NYSE size-decile portfolio.
Categorize new FY1 forecast relative to the same analyst’s prior forecast and the prior consensus: +1 above both, −1 below both, 0 between; thresholds/timing must follow source date rules.
Indicator for annual maximum count of analysts with an outstanding one-year-ahead forecast above the annual sample median.
Multiply the annual high-coverage indicator by Signal; preserve both the annual sample-median population and signal comparison inputs.
Indicator for II rank 1–3 or runner-up in the latest prior annual industry ranking; ranking-name linkage to I/B/E/S analyst identity is unverified.
Multiply the All-Star indicator by Signal.
Indicator for WSJ industry rank 1–5 in the latest prior annual ranking; ranking-name linkage to I/B/E/S identity is unverified.
Multiply the Earnings-Estimator indicator by Signal.
Market-adjusted return over the previous six months, ending at day t−2.
Natural log of firm market capitalization at the end of the last calendar year; winsorize the extreme 1% tails.
Firm book-to-market at the end of the last calendar year; the paper does not define its exact accounting/equity components; winsorize extreme 1% tails.
